 Bar chart race maker Animated ranking video maker Leaderboard video maker Race chart generator CSV to video chart Flourish alternative Line chart race maker Top 10 animation maker 

 Frequently asked questions
 What can I make with Movrank?
 Movrank creates animated ranking videos, including bar chart races, line chart races, leaderboard videos and top-list animations.

 Can I make a bar chart race from a CSV?
 Yes. Upload a CSV exported from Excel or Google Sheets, choose the series you want to show, style the chart and export the animation as a video.

 Can I paste data from a spreadsheet?
 Yes. You can paste spreadsheet data or build a dataset by hand when you do not have a CSV file ready.

 Can I export MP4 videos for social media?
 Yes. Movrank exports MP4 videos in landscape, square and vertical formats for YouTube, TikTok, Reels and presentations.

 Do I need code or video editing software?
 No. Movrank is a no-code chart race maker, so you do not need Python, After Effects or a separate video editor.

 Ready to make your first ranking video?
 Free to start. Upgrade any time for more videos, 1080p, every aspect ratio and your own watermark.
